name: JJGA 特定非営利活動法人日本ジュニアゴルフ協会 — 決勝大会 results, 15-18歳 boys/girls divisions (石川遼カップ中高生決勝, Jr.プレーヤーズ東西決勝, オールスター, 東横イン決勝, RMJ 宮里・青木・成田カップ, 小平智カップ決勝, スプリング/大東建託 東西決勝, サマージュニアクラシック, あるふぁくらぶ)
publishes: Per-event result PDFs (linked from each /final/... event page; 2015年度 and earlier as direct PDFs). 15-18 division rows: rank, (to-par), name, grade (circled 1-3; some PDFs add a 種類 column 高校/中学), 所在地 prefecture, OUT/IN per round, round totals, total. NO school names.
years_available: Finals listed on /result for 1995-2026; collected: events played 2016-02 (2015年度 Ishikawa Cup) through 2026-06 (2026年度 Jr.Players West), i.e. 2015年度 Ishikawa Cup + 2016年度-2026年度 finals
terms_note: robots.txt (checked 2026-10-12) only disallows /wp/wp-admin/. JJGA Webサービス利用規約 (https://www.jjga.org/common/pdf/agreement.pdf) 第8条 prohibits reproduction/secondary use without consent. Owner decision 2026-10-12: publish facts only (names, positions, scores, prefecture, grade) with source links, and ask JJGA for consent in parallel (reference/source_terms.json 'jjga-'). Server resets connections intermittently: fetched with retries and >=1.2 s between requests.
reason: Collected 2026-10-12 into data/raw/jjga/jjga-<event>-<year>-<boys|girls>-15-18.json (one file per event x year x division; id year = calendar year of play, so e.g. the 2015年度 Ishikawa Cup played Feb 2016 is ...-2016-...). All 89 in-scope finals have both 15-18 divisions.
